title: SEQUENCE truncates dimensions, advances by stored additions, and puts #NUM! only in overflowing cells
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, SEQUENCE(rows, [columns], [start], [step]) coerces its arguments in formula order, truncates positive fractional dimensions (requiring rows*columns >= 1, else #CALC!; negative or invalid dimensions give #VALUE!), and advances each cell in row-major order by one stored binary64 addition cur = cur + step rather than start + k*step. When accumulation overflows finite binary64, only the overflowing cells become #NUM! while earlier cells retain finite values.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in f3_arrays (rows 1-2) and dc-ymjf.2.68 / dc-ymjf.2.70 tests (crates/calc-func/tests/f3_arrays.rs), and matched across 1,567/1,567 full-bank SEQUENCE rows.
